__description_regex_comment__: To disable the regex search & replace of the transaction description, set both to an empty string.
__ignore_counterparty_iban_regex_comment: Optional. Firefly III looks up the destination account by IBAN first. For payments settled through a payment processor (e.g. card payments) the IBAN is shared by many merchants and they all end up on the same account. If this regex matches the booking text or the description of a transaction, only the counterparty name is sent to Firefly III. Such a transaction is never turned into a transfer. Leave empty to disable.

choose_account_automation.__from_to_comment__: The following values will be passed directly into DateTime. Set them to null to choose them manually during import process.
